comments: Submitted by the vendor (A2Z Tools). The tool runs entirely in the browser; colours are not uploaded. A companion tool, the A2Z PDF Accessibility Checker, is submitted separately.
features: Browser-based contrast matrix: enter a colour palette and see every foreground/background pair, including hover and disabled states and translucent colours, scored against WCAG 2.2 AA and AAA text and non-text contrast thresholds. Export the matrix as CSV. Free, no sign-up.
title: A2Z Accessibility Contrast Matrix
